labs.title: JSON REST endpoint (+ httptest)
labs.goal: Expose a /healthz endpoint that returns JSON, then verify it end-to-end with httptest — the standard way to ship and test an HTTP handler in Go.
steps: Define a Health struct with JSON tags.
Write a handler that sets Content-Type and encodes JSON.
Spin up an httptest.Server, GET the endpoint, decode the body.
Print status code + fields to prove the contract.

labs.title: Bounded worker pool
labs.goal: Process a batch of jobs with a fixed number of goroutines — the canonical Go pattern for bounded concurrency (image resizing, API fan-out, etc.).
steps: Start N workers that read jobs, compute, and write results.
Feed jobs from a producer goroutine, then close the input.
Close output once all workers finish (WaitGroup), collect and sort.

labs.title: Graceful HTTP shutdown
labs.goal: Run an http.Server and shut it down cleanly with a context deadline — required for zero-downtime deploys and clean container stops (SIGTERM).
steps: Start ListenAndServe in a goroutine; treat ErrServerClosed as normal.
On a shutdown trigger, call srv.Shutdown(ctx) with a timeout.
Print confirmation once in-flight requests drain.

labs.title: Cancellable pipeline
labs.goal: Build a tiny pipeline: generate ints 1..5, square them in workers, print sum — cancel via context.
steps: Producer sends 1..5 on a channel and closes it.
Workers read, square, send to out channel.
Main sums out until closed; call cancel in a defer.
